03/10.07.2025 I.A. No. 8470 of 2025 Heard Mr. N.K. Sahani, the learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Shailendra Kumar Tiwari, the learned Spl.P.P. for the State.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offences under sections 376(1), 341, 323, 454 of the Indian Penal Code and section 66-E of the Information and Technology Act and has been sentenced to undergo RI for 20 years along with a fine of Rs.10,000/- for the offence under section 376(1) of the Indian Penal Code.
It has been alleged that the appellant had entered into the house of the informant and had committed rape upon her.
Submission has been advanced by the learned counsel for the appellant that the medical report does not indicate that the victim was subjected to any unnatural offence as alleged.
It has further been submitted that the appellant is in custody since 05.11.2022.
Learned Spl.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant.

It seems that the victim, who has been examined as PW-4, has categorically stated about the act of sexual abuse committed upon her by the appellant and the medical report indicates some scratch marks were found on the body of the victim.
